page: Microsoft Azure E64ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eadsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical AMD EPYC 9V45 cores operating at 4.5 GHz. The memory configuration consists of 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 3780 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core CPU execution, PassMark CPU score, and PassMark memory score. Memory bandwidth tests show strong results in the top 25% for both small-block cached reads and large-block uncached read/write operations. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also rank in the top 10%.

Database operations on this server rank in the top 10% for PassMark database benchmarks, supported by strong Redis SET operations in the top 25%. For machine learning workloads, the CPU-based LLM inference speeds for small (135M) and medium (7B) models rank in the top 10% to top 25%. However, a performance tradeoff is observed with larger models; LLM inference speeds for a large 70B model drop to average levels, placing in the middle 50%.

Given the high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and the inclusion of a fast 3780 GB local NVMe SSD, the E64ads_v7 offers high resource density for memory-bound and storage-intensive workloads without requiring external disk attachments. This hardware profile is suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data-intensive web serving, and medium-scale analytical processing.

It features 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high 8.0 GB per core ratio, alongside a bundled 3780 GB local NVMe SSD. Benchmark results place the server in the top 10% for single-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU and memory scores, and database operations. It also achieves strong top 25% ratings in multi-core performance and memory bandwidth. This server is suited for memory-intensive databases, in-memory caching, and data processing workloads.
